raw_segments.text: Benedict, will your grace command me any service to the world's end?
I will go on the slightest errand now to the antipodes that you can devise to send me on.
I will fetch you a toothpicker now from the furthest inch of Asia.
Bring you the length of Prester John's foot.
Fetch you a hair off the great cam's beard.
Do you any embassage to the pygmies rather than hold three words conference with this
You have no employment for me.
